text: Stephen Curry pulls up from thirty feet and buries it. The Warriors lead the Lakers 88 to 85 with four minutes left in the third quarter.
LeBron James drives baseline, and finishes with the left hand. That cuts it to 101 to 99, one minute twenty to play.
Timeout on the floor. Golden State has scored eight straight, and the Lakers coach is not happy at all.
Anthony Davis with the block! The Lakers take the lead, 104 to 103, with forty two seconds remaining.
Welcome back to Chase Center, where tonight's crowd is the biggest of the season.
Draymond Green picks up his fourth foul, and he will head to the bench for the rest of the quarter.
Saka cuts inside, shoots, and it's a goal! Arsenal lead Chelsea two to one in the seventy eighth minute.
That's a red card for Chelsea! They will have to play the final ten minutes with ten men.
The goalkeeper gathers it comfortably, and Arsenal will look to build from the back.
Into the ninetieth minute now, and there will be four minutes of added time. Still one nil to Arsenal.
Mahomes finds Kelce in the end zone, touchdown Kansas City! The Chiefs lead the Bills 24 to 20.
Josh Allen is picked off! Interception at the forty yard line, with one minute fifty left in the game.
The Bills will settle for a field goal attempt from thirty eight yards out.
Breaking news this evening: a magnitude five earthquake has been reported near San Jose, California.
In business news, shares of Nvidia rose four percent after the company reported record quarterly earnings.
The weather in Redwood City tomorrow will be sunny, with a high of seventy two degrees.
